record.description: Proposed extension O_(r,i)(t)=P_(i,t)[T_(r,t)(S_t)]+η_(r,i)(t) for inversions when states and measurement operators change over time. This is new synthesis in the conversation, not previously proven theorem.
record.note: A genuine new modeling proposal in the audit record; source attribution and dynamic identifiability remain open. Time-indexed state and changing readouts require separate calibration, declared dynamics, observability/identifiability conditions and held-out times. M-05 was already a Mathematical Audit synthesis; this correction adds explicit lineage, not a newly proven theorem.
